propositions: Whole-body pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts content: escapes punctuation inside code spans, deletes HTML comments like `<!-- rebar:reconciler-echo -->`, and rewrites `-->` to `-→` when substituting arrows, all without visible errors in hand-written examples

A two-phase segmenting lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks in phase 1, then classify remaining text as safe (exact pass-through), ambiguous wiki markers (unambiguous vs ambiguous per CommonMark risk), tables (wrapped once in {noformat}), HTML tags, regex-dangerous prose, or pandoc-rendered content

Code fragments and arrows require pre-substitution masking and post-render verification: every code fragment from source must appear verbatim in output or the entire unit falls back to identity, and arrow mapping must preserve `<!--`/`-->` delimiters by matching them first

The fixed deterministic corpus of 178 bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must achieve >=0.90 body-ratio and >=0.95 character-ratio coverage with non-vacuous dispatched-and-changed verification, pinned cardinality, and exclusion of emails, URLs, and tenant hostnames

Pre-existing Jira wiki markup (bold `*x*`, italic `_x_`, monospace `{{x}}`, color `{color:name}...{color}`, links `[label|target]`) must pass exactly through all five rendering passes without oscillation, requiring split classification of unambiguous forms that settle a unit inside bullets versus ambiguous `*strong*`/`_emphasis_` only in plain prose

Missing pandoc returns exact body with warning event `wiki_render_fallback(reason='pandoc_absent')`, conversion or preservation failure returns exact unit with debug event using `'conversion_failure'` or `'preservation_failure'` reason, module state is immutable, and `WikiTextCodec` / live sends remain unchanged (unwired pure renderer)
